results.text: Effect of treatment with nebivolol on parameters of oxidative stress in type 2 diabetics with mild to moderate hypertension. The aim of this study was to examine the effect of the cadioselective B(1)-adrenoceptor blocker nebivolol on glycaemic control, lipid profile and markers of oxidative stress in patients with type 2 diabetes over a 6-month period.

results.text: Comparison of nebivolol, carvedilol, and bisoprolol for adverse clinical outcomes among patients with heart failure-a real-world nationwide investigation. The authors report a retrospective cohort study based on a national dataset that explores the association between the prescription of three beta-blockers (BB) and a diagnosis of heart failure (HF) readmission, cardiovascular (CV) death, and all-cause death.
